summary.name: AI Art Style Reference
summary.one_liner: A reference page on Aiartes listing hundreds of artist names tagged "Beauty Style" for use in AI image prompting.
use_cases: Finding artist names to use in AI image prompts
Choosing an illustration style for AI-generated art
summary.what_it_does: The page is a flat list of artist names, each tagged with the label "Beauty Style". It includes many illustrators, painters, comic artists and animators, such as Alphonse Mucha, Gustav Klimt, Makoto Shinkai and Frank Frazetta. Many names appear multiple times in the text, and the page itself gives no description of how the styles are used. The listing in eudk/awesome-ai-tools describes it as a platform for exploring AI-generated art and references under 'Tools for better image prompting'.
notable: Large list of artist names tagged as style references for AI image prompts
Covers illustration, painting, comics and anime artists
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under image prompting tools
caveats: Page is only a name list; no description of features, tools or how to use the styles
Names repeat many times on the page, suggesting duplicated entries
Pricing and terms are not stated on the page
